layout.spacing: Generous Spacing: p-6, p-12, p-24. Padding inside cards. Avoid cramming.

grids.general: Mode A (Tetris Grid) - Asymmetrical, bento-style with varying column spans.
grids.teacher_guide: Mode B (Control Room) - Denser, structured bento grid with strict data hierarchy.

layout.surfaces: Retro-Futurism (Terminal Look). Containers use 1px borders with subtle neon drop-shadows. No soft blurred shadows.

components.cards: Dark background (`bg-[#1A0F3D]`) with `border border-[#39FF14]/30`. On hover: `border-[#FF5E00]` and add a drop-shadow glow. Sharp corners or max `rounded-md`.
components.buttons: Flat solid background. Primary CTA: `bg-[#FF5E00] text-black`. Hover states: lighten hue and add drop-shadow glow. No pill shapes, stick to sharp/slight radius.
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#090514]/80`, `border-b border-white/10`. Nav links should have high contrast.
components.gallery: Asymmetric masonry grid with hover scale and slight rotation on images. Always use a dark purple gradient overlay `bg-gradient-to-t from-[#090514] via-transparent to-transparent` to blend images into the background.
components.reader: Narrow column `max-w-prose` for readability. Pull quotes should have a thick left border in neon orange.

motion.hover: Scale 1.02, border color shift to neon green/orange, glow effect.
motion.scrolling: Smooth scrolling effects. Fade-in up staggered animations for chapter cards and lists.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive and informational elements have `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
Use 'Unbounded' for headings (H1-H4) and 'Manrope' for body text. Import them via Google Fonts.
Avoid generic Tailwind colors (like blue-500, gray-100). Rely strictly on the neon hex codes provided in this guide.
Implement 'Tracing Beam' or glowing borders for chapter cards to enhance the retro-tech EDM aesthetic.
The Teacher's Guide view must feel distinct: apply a 'Control Room' grid layout—denser, more analytical than the immersive main chapters.
Add dark overlays (`bg-black/50` or `bg-gradient-to-t from-[#090514]`) to all hero and full-bleed images to ensure text readability.
Do not use placeholder image URLs. Use the exact provided image_urls for authentic underground vibe.
